newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Erciyas buys 38.6 pct of investment trust.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Erciyas buys 38.6 pct of investment trust.

text.p: Turkish brewer Erciyas Biracilik ve Malt Sanayii A.S. bought a 38.6 percent stake in Alternatif Yatirim Ortakligi, the Istanbul Stock Exchange said in a statement on Tuesday.
Alternatifbank had offered 49 percent of its capital to the public on August 19-23. Erciyas bought 96.54 billion lira of 122.5 billion lira nominal-valued shares at a price of 1,450 lira per share.
Alternatif Yatirim was owned 96 percent by Alternatifbank before the public offer.
The bank, owned 80 percent by Turkish brewery, automotive and stationary group Anadolu Endustri Holding, said it had gained a net profit of 49.8 billion lira from the sell-off.
